name: Myrddraxis

facts.text: Level 80, 100,000 health, a hydra with four further heads (second to fifth) that rise with it.
Each head's bite heals the body by half the damage it deals and the other heads by a tenth.
Stunning breath at 80/60/40/20% health; a Breath of Annihilation over the area at 75/50/25%.
On death: 'The earth lurches beneath your feet as Myrddraxis staggers and topples to the ground.'
Bot chat: the heads heal each other; a raid of fifty fought it for an hour; rumour of a scale that never breaks.

story:
Myrddraxis was an egg once, small enough to carry, found by Fomorian hydrars in the black sand under Hy Brasil. They raised it in the lowest cistern of their city and fed it the way they feed their pride: generously, and on their enemies. It grew five heads. Each one is a mouth for the same hunger, and what any head tears from a victim goes straight to the great body under the water and to its sister heads, so that the hydra grows whole as it feeds. The trained shrillers scream round it so it never quite sleeps. When it is hurt it breathes, and its breath is of two kinds: one that leaves warriors stunned and staring, and one that the keepers call annihilation.

The hydrars sing three lines to it, and the lines are the whole of its life: eat, and be whole; eat, and be many; eat, and be ours. It has done all three. It grew from an egg found in the black sand into a thing of five heads and a great sunken body that no Fomorian has ever seen wholly out of the water. The shrillers on the cistern walls are trained to scream at it day and night, so that it never sleeps. A thing that never sleeps, the Sylvan say, never forgets an insult, and Myrddraxis has had many raids to remember.

Every head is a mouth for the same hunger. What a head bites from a victim goes to the body under the water, half of it, and a little to each of its sister heads, so that the hydra grows whole as it feeds and the heads mend one another. That is the truth behind the old tavern story that its heads heal each other. Its breath comes in two kinds: a stunning breath that leaves warriors staring, at each fifth of its strength, and the breath of annihilation at each quarter, a sheet of flame across the whole cistern. When it finally dies the earth lurches, and on the mound where it lay a glowing light forms, as it does where dragons fall. The Fomorians think it more than a beast. They call it the city's luck.
legend: The heads feed the body with every bite, so the heads die first, and nobody lets a head chew on them longer than they must. Expect a stun breath every fifth of its health and a big area breath at each quarter: healers spread, purge the stuns. The stair is too narrow for a full raid; bring groups that know their jobs. Cut the heads one at a time with the whole group, starting with whichever is biting the healers. Purge the stuns fast; heal through the annihilation. Bring more groups than you think, because the cistern is wide. Superstition: shout no insult at the hydra from the ledge. It never sleeps, and it never forgets.

loremasterTopic.text: The hydra of Fomor, raised from an egg by the hydrars. Five heads, one hunger: every head's bite feeds the body. Cut the heads first.

bookPage: The hydrars of Fomor sing to their beast. Fiachra of Howth heard the song from a ledge and a Sylvan put words to it for him afterwards: eat, and be whole; eat, and be many; eat, and be ours. The heads bit, and the body grew whole. He asked the Sylvan how one kills such a thing. She said you starve it. Cut the mouths and the belly follows. He asked how long that takes. She said it depends how many friends you bring, and how much they mind being bitten. The realm's bands bring more every year, she said, and the hydrars sing louder.
